claim: Admission and pressure recording only. FT4.1 remains pending until fulfillment/suspension and native request formation are integrated; FT4.2 owns paid route selection and FT4.3 owns autonomous closure/reuse.

implementation_limit.bounded_evaluation: both native content settings and the 64-cell binary pressure panel

owned_inputs: Discover current unretracted paid native c6.need or c7ws.need bindings from the actor participant view. Preserve exact actor, context, cue, target, binding and native need payload. No evaluator route, desired cell or goal sequence enters this policy. Initial owned intentions are input task state, not evidence of autonomous goal invention.
admission: Admit each exact owned need identity/revision at most once; preserve first-seen age and deterministic actor/reference tie order. Keep contradictory task requirements as separate unresolved obligations. A missing or retracted need suspends it with evidence, never labels it fulfilled. Bounded intake records omitted eligible identities and a resumable cursor.
pressure: Record the exact historical predicate: any pending packet lands on A3 or A4 AND Creative A2 charge is empty. Wallet emptiness, retained history and packet counts are separate. Do not clear pending or refill charge. Pressure alone cannot fabricate content or a scoped task.
outcomes: This sub-batch creates no fulfilled state or capability. Follow-up FT4.1b must define fulfillment from the actual paid native outcome/consumer and preserve inaccessible, incomplete, failed, stale and unsupported demands. No completion from a selected route label.
causal_controls: unread or partial demand access cannot admit a task
foreign demand cannot admit a task for this actor
retracted or disputed demand cannot remain active
hidden material revisions alone do not alter owned demand payload
a newly paid owned need changes admission
duplicate scanning grants neither a new demand nor a new age
bounded intake does not silently drop work
checkpoint restoration preserves ordered demand state and the next admission
false actor/reference/age audit rows are rejected
audit: Independently reconstruct admission, exact owned receipt and need scope from raw journal/saved participant observations. Auditor must not import admission, selector, scheduler or executors; it may use record codecs and structural constants. Include tampered evidence and no-hidden-state controls.
gate: Every declared case passes with unchanged source, independent rejection controls and exact restart. Record exact method identities and all outcomes; no FT4-wide acceptance.
next_subbatch: FT4.1b: integrate actual unresolved tasks, requests, pressure, explicit outcome fulfillment and suspension into versioned controller; prospectively register any additional completion hypothesis.
